name: unity-polygon-streaming-animated-glb
description: Play embedded animation clips from a streamed XRG (from GLB/FBX) using StreamingModelAnimator + a custom RuntimeAnimatorController. Covers Animation Mode, dummy-clip matching, PlayAnimation / triggers / floats / bools / ints, morph target weights, and runtime controller swap.
prerequisites: StreamController in the scene with Viewer Camera assigned
An XRG whose source GLB/FBX contains embedded animation clips
